# Varnish Cache Metrics Receiver

The receiver fetches metric data from a running [Varnish Cache] or [Vinyl Cache] instance. 

| Status        |           |
| ------------- |-----------|
| Stability     | [alpha]: metrics   |
| Unsupported Platforms | windows |
| Distributions | [varnishotelcollector] |

## Prerequisites

This receiver supports [Varnish Cache] and [Vinyl Cache] versions `8.x` and higher. 

A CGo toolchain and `libvarnishapi` must be installed for creating C bindings. 

## Configuration

By default, no settings are required. 

| Field               | Default | Description                                                                                        |
|---------------------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `working_directory` | `""`    | The working directory of the Varnish instance. This maps to the `-n` parameter for `varnishd`.     |
| `include_tags`      | []      | A list of globs for excluding fields. See *varnishstat(1)* for more details on the `-I` parameter. |
| `exclude_tags`      | []      | A list of globs for excluding fields. See *varnishstat(1)* for more details on the `-X` parameter. |

The full schema can be found in [config.schema.yaml](./config.schema.yaml).

## Examples

#### Minimal metrics

This example exports a minimal set of metrics.

```yaml
receivers:
  varnishcachestat:
    include_tags:
      - "MAIN.*"
      - "MGT.*"
```

#### Replacement for [prometheus_varnish_exporter]

This example exports metrics in the same way as [prometheus_varnish_exporter]
to be used as a drop-in replacement. 

```yaml
receivers:
  varnishcachestat: {}

exporters:
  varnishcachestat/prometheus:
    endpoint: "0.0.0.0:9131"
    enable_open_metrics: true
    translation_strategy: "UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes"
    without_scope_info: true # removes otel_* labels in Prometheus HTTP output
    resource_to_telemetry_conversion:
      enabled: true
    namespace: varnish
```

## Known Limitations

### Differences to [prometheus_varnish_exporter]

(this vs. exporter)

- `varnish_backend_happy` is not exported vs `varnish_backend_happy` exported
- `varnish_vcp_ref_hit` vs. `varnish_main_vcp_ref_hit` - `VCP.*` has own namespace in VSC
- `varnish_waiter_pool0_action` vs `varnish_main_waiter_pool0_action` - `WAITER.*` has own namespace in VSC
- `varnish_waiter_pool0_action{id="pool0"}` vs `varnish_main_waiter_pool0_action{id="waiter.pool0"}` - incorrect parsing of waiter pool as `waiter.*`
- `varnish_sma_g_alloc{type="Transient"}` vs `varnish_sma_g_alloc{type="transient"}` - Labels for `SMA.*` are lowercased and differ from what is set via `varnishd`

If the feature gate `receiver.varnishcachestat.breakPrometheusExporterCompat` is active, the following also applies:

- `WAITER.(.*).<metric>` is renamed to `waiter_<metric>` and the `id` labels is added for the name of the waiter;
  - For example: `WAITER.w1.conns` is renamed to `waiter_conns {id="w1"}`

[Varnish Cache]: https://www.varnish.org/
[Vinyl Cache]: https://vinyl-cache.org/
[prometheus_varnish_exporter]: https://github.com/otto-de/prometheus_varnish_exporter
